founder_json.name: Lemma content owner
founder_json.audience: founder-led teams, operators, content teams, creators, and brand leads replacing scattered content workflows with one grounded operating loop
audience_signals: They are skeptical of generic AI writing tools.
They care about real workflow ownership, not demos.
They want concrete examples of how pods replace scattered tools.
They respond to strong product beliefs backed by shipped proof.

product_json.one_line_description: Lemma lets teams build pods: AI-native operating systems with data, files, agents, workflows, integrations, and apps in one workspace.
allowed_claims: A Lemma pod packages data, documents, automation, AI agents, and UI inside one permission boundary.
Pods are built as local directory bundles and imported progressively.
One pod can replace a scattered stack of point tools for a focused operating loop.
Lemma apps are custom React workbenches for humans operating the pod.
Agents and functions have zero access by default and need explicit grants.
blocked_claims: Lemma auto-posts to social networks in V1.
Lemma removes the need for human decisions.
Every company can replace all software with one pod immediately.
proof_points: LEDflex support workflow is a real pod-style deployment pattern.
Coach Carter shows Telegram capture, structured tables, functions, and an app working together.
The Content Pod is being built directory-first with seeded records and phase-by-phase verification.
The local bundle includes tables, functions, agents, payloads, and desk specs before import.
